baseline: inaugural run — no prior baseline file

findings.name: PMRF blind face restoration
findings.notes: ICLR 2025 paper. 230M params. Posterior-mean rectified flow beats CodeFormer on moderate degradation with lower VRAM (3.3 GB vs ~8 GB). MIT license. ComfyUI-PMRF node is stable. Do NOT use fsxedx/PMRF fork (Jul 27 upload, unverified account).

findings.name: PMRF blind face restoration (face pass upgrade)
findings.notes: Replace CodeFormer pass in photo restore pipeline with PMRF for the face-enhancement stage. Augmentation, not full replacement.

findings.name: SeedVR2 native ComfyUI (v0.28.0)
findings.notes: ComfyUI v0.28.0 (Jul 15, 2026) merged SeedVR2 into core. Builders can reference native SeedVR2 node class names without the third-party custom node. Confirm local ComfyUI >= v0.28.0 before migrating.

findings.name: Krea 2 Turbo
findings.notes: ~12B params, 8-step distilled. ComfyUI-native repo. Top-tier arena quality (~1150-1185 Elo). Non-commercial license — legal review required before production. Add as arch: 'krea2_turbo' preset; do not enable as default until license reviewed. Also applies to build_img2img and build_generate_anything.

findings.name: HiDream O1 9B FP8
findings.notes: 9B unified image gen + editing, MIT license, top-tier quality. FP8 dev variant ~10 GB — comfortable on 16 GB. ComfyUI native support in place. Best open-license option at this quality tier. Also applies to build_txt2img and build_generate_anything.

findings.name: Wan-Dancer-14B
findings.notes: Portrait image + audio track -> beat-synchronized dance video at 720p/30fps up to ~1 min. Uses WanDancerEncodeAudio + WanDancerVideo nodes (ComfyUI Partner Nodes). FP8/int8 quant fits 16 GB. New builder needed — cannot wire until WanDancer nodes installed on ComfyUI server. Apache 2.0 license.

findings.name: BFS-Best-Face-Swap LoRA update (Jul 30)
findings.notes: 567K downloads, 724 likes. Jul 30 commit may include BFS Head V3 weights. Most-adopted Klein/Flux2 face-swap LoRA. Pull latest weights; diff commit log to confirm Head V3; update builder's default BFS LoRA path if confirmed. Also applies to build_klein_face_detail.

findings.name: ComfyUI-INT4-Fast
findings.notes: On-the-fly INT4 (W4A4 convrot) quantization at load time; no pre-quantized checkpoint needed. Reduces effective VRAM by ~50-60% vs FP16. Cross-cutting benefit for ALL Flux-based builders. VERIFY RTX 5060 Ti (Blackwell) Tensor Core compatibility — node targets Ada/Ampere; Blackwell should be compatible but needs a test run first.

findings.name: GLM-Image 7B
findings.notes: 7B params, MIT license. Unique 4-reference image style transfer — no other open-weight model has this at comparable quality. FP8 ~16 GB (tight, at VRAM ceiling). FP16 ~30 GB exceeds budget. Evaluate FP8 variant for build_style_transfer as an alternative path when multi-reference style is needed.

findings.name: FLUX 3
findings.notes: API + early-access only. No open weights. No ComfyUI node. Watch condition: BFL releases 'FLUX 3 Dev' open weights.

findings.name: MiniMax H3
findings.notes: Open weights promised 'within days' but not yet on HuggingFace as of Jul 31. Watch: MiniMaxAI HuggingFace org publishes weights.

findings.name: Qwen-Image-3.0
findings.notes: API only (chat.qwen.ai). No weights, no benchmarks, no technical report. Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 remains best local option. Watch: Qwen/Qwen-Image-3.0 appears on HuggingFace.

findings.name: HunyuanVideo-1.5 GGUF
findings.notes: GGUF + CPU offload opens a 16 GB path for HunyuanVideo-1.5 I2V 720p if system RAM >= 32 GB. Quality vs standard quantization is unverified. Evaluate on local hardware before shipping.

findings.name: FaceFusion 3.8.0
findings.notes: Plumbing release (FFmpeg-native video manager, AV1 support). No new swap model. Relevant only if builders call FaceFusion subprocess. Watch: FaceFusion 4.0 with new swap architecture.

findings.name: LTX-2.3
findings.notes: 22B params. 18-21 GB BF16 — exceeds 16 GB budget. Watch: community int4/Q4 GGUF that fits 16 GB with acceptable quality.

findings.name: Wan 2.7
findings.notes: API-only (WaveSpeed/DashScope). No open weights for local ComfyUI as of Jul 31. Watch: Wan-AI HuggingFace org publishes Wan 2.7 weights.

findings.name: Ideogram 4.0
findings.notes: Non-commercial license. FP8 exactly at 16 GB ceiling. Watch: license becomes commercial OR confirmed FP8 budget margin.

findings.name: FLUX.2-klein-9b-kv
findings.notes: KV-cache variant of Klein-9B. Speeds inference; same architecture. Low priority unless Klein latency is a current bottleneck.

findings.name: RTX Video Super Resolution
findings.notes: Driver-level, near-zero VRAM. RTX 5060 Ti natively supported. Requires nvidia-vfx Python package install. Windows-only. Install on server if build_video_upscale needs a faster path.

findings.name: ComfyUI-PuLID-Flux2 v0.6.2
findings.notes: v0.6.2 adds Klein 4B/9B support. No July update. Verify currently installed version against 0.6.2 — this is already actionable.

findings.name: Wan2.2-S2V-14B
findings.notes: Story-to-video (image + story text -> video). Novel capability not covered by any existing builder. Consider new build_wan_s2v builder.

findings.name: UniVidX
findings.notes: 14B video DiT for intrinsic decomposition / video matting. Niche VFX use. 16 GB FP8 unconfirmed. Evaluate for relighting / alpha-compositing workflows.

findings.name: NVIDIA PID 1.5 PixelDiT
findings.notes: Partner-node API route (key required). No confirmed local weights. Watch: confirmed open weights release.

findings.name: Seedream 5 Pro
findings.notes: API-only partner node. No local weights. Watch: open weights release.

findings.name: HunyuanVideo-Foley
findings.notes: Text/video-to-audio generation. No audio builder exists in spellcaster. Add audio builder capability when roadmap allows.

findings.name: Wan2.2-Animate-14B
findings.notes: build_wan_animate_video already covers this model (21K downloads). Verify that the current build_wan_animate_video weights path matches the Sep 2025 release.
